findings.state: Default screen after any discovery run: the line under the search heading
findings.current: {t("Last search")} {date or "just now"} · {run.eventsWritten} {t("events returned")} · {run.status}  → e.g. "Last search 11/16/2026 · 7 events returned · throttled" (raw enum: completed | throttled | failed | running)
findings.problem: The raw ledger status key is printed to the user. "throttled" does not tell a first-time user that the search was limited to directly relevant events because the weekly search budget was half used (index.ts:166,129-131); "running" for a stuck row is paired with "just now" (line 142) even if the run started days ago. High-context dependence + semantic compression; the DS screen already maps these keys to sentences (ds/lib/adapters.ts:311-317) but v4 does not.
findings.governing: comprehension principle; COPY_STANDARD.md §13/§17 (state names an observable condition)
findings.proposed: Map the status before rendering, e.g. in OutdoorsEventsV4.tsx add const RUN_STATUS_TEXT = { completed: t("completed"), throttled: t("limited to directly relevant events because this week's search budget is partly used", {class:"body"}), failed: t("did not finish"), running: t("still in progress"), paused: t("paused: this week's search budget is used up", {class:"body"}) } and render {RUN_STATUS_TEXT[run.status]} instead of {run.status}; for the date use run.completedAt ?? run.startedAt instead of the literal "just now".

findings.state: Default screen, × button on any event row (title "Dismiss"); same behavior behind "Delete" on the DS (ds/components/EventListDS.tsx:217-223) and oldest (components/EventRow.tsx:341-349) screens
findings.current: title="Dismiss" → removeEvent(ev.id) → deleteOutdoorsEvent → hard DELETE of the row (state.ts:181-191, lib/persistence.ts:165-177). No confirmation.

OWNER DECISION: make the × set status to "passed" (changeStatus(ev.id, "passed")) and hide passed/archived rows from the tier groups, so a dismissal survives later searches; keep hard delete only for manually added rows.
